Here's a summary of the bugs found and fixed:

### Root level
| # | Issue | Fix |
|---|-------|-----|
| 1 | **Import breaks on fresh clones** — `Import` of `eng\custom-analyzers.props` had no existence guard | Added `Condition="Exists(...)"` |
| 2 | **`CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` set too late** — in `.targets`, but the SDK reads it *before* targets are evaluated | Moved to `Directory.Build.props` |
| 3 | **Code-gen not extensible** — `RunCodeGen` was monolithic with no hook points | Added empty `BeforeRunCodeGen`/`AfterRunCodeGen` targets that other teams can override |

### `hard/` subdirectory
| # | Issue | Fix |
|---|-------|-----|
| 4 | **Circular import condition** — `Common.props` imported only when `CommonPropsImported == true`, but that property is *defined inside* `Common.props` | Changed to `Exists()` guard |
| 5 | **Wildcard imports disabled** — `ImportByWildcard*` set to `false`, breaking NuGet package auto-import (`MyAnalyzer.BuildTasks` build hook) | Removed the suppression |
| 6 | **`CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` too late** (same as #2) | Moved to `Directory.Build.props` |
| 7 | **Unguarded import** of `$(RepoToolsPath)\code-analysis.targets` (undefined path due to #4) | Added `Exists()` guard |
| 8 | **Target name collision** — `GenerateAssemblyInfo` shadows the SDK built-in | Renamed to `GenerateCustomAssemblyInfo` |
| 9 | **Depends on internal target** — `_CopyFilesMarkedCopyLocal` (underscore = private, may vanish) | Changed to public `CopyFilesToOutputDirectory` |
